note: Grade-by-grade checklist for Home and the senior timeline on Colleges. 'month' is when it usually happens (1–12); 'date' only where the official date is fixed. Check each college's own deadlines.

9.text: Join one or two clubs or activities you actually enjoy
Start logging volunteer hours from day one, with a supervisor for each
Meet your counselor and sketch a 4-year course plan (in California, check the UC/CSU A–G list)
Make your first semester count. Freshman grades go on your transcript
Look for a free summer program, camp or volunteer role
Write down every activity, award and job so far

10.text: Take the PSAT 10 or PSAT 8/9 if your school offers it (practice for junior year)
Go deeper in one or two activities: aim for a bigger role or project
Check your volunteer hours against your goal
Choose junior-year classes: challenge yourself where you're strong
Apply to summer programs and competitions (many close Jan–Mar)
Update your activities list and resume

11.text: Take the PSAT/NMSQT in October: junior scores decide National Merit
Start a college list with reach, match and likely schools
Plan your SAT or ACT: first try by spring, retake in summer or fall if needed
Apply to summer programs, research and internships
Ask two junior-year teachers for recommendation letters before summer
Take your AP exams in May
Visit colleges (virtual tours count) and note what you like
Draft your personal essay (and the UC Personal Insight Questions if applying to UCs)
Turn your activities into a Common App-style list

12.text: Common App opens August 1: create your account and finalize your list
Confirm recommenders and request transcripts and test scores
Fill out the FAFSA (and CSS Profile if your colleges require it) as soon as it opens
Early Action and Early Decision deadlines are usually Nov 1 or Nov 15
University of California application due November 30 (filing opens Oct 1)
Cal State applications open Oct 1. Check Cal State Apply for this year's deadline
Regular Decision deadlines are usually Jan 1–15
Apply to scholarships: many close January through March
Compare financial aid offers side by side, and ask about appeals
National College Decision Day: commit and pay your deposit by May 1
Send your final transcript and thank your recommenders
